0.why: docs/modules/FranKe/Manual.md, CLOCK SOURCE: BPM-CV is valid over -6V to +6V and converts like V/octave, 0V giving 120 BPM; the module is monophonic, no setChannels anywhere in FranKeModule::process

7.why: the SETUP hint text for this jack reads 'Pattern by CV (0V/+10V) unipolar 0V/+10V'

comment: Source is not published; read against the maker's manuals at tag v2.6.13. Every parameter is configured with an empty name, so the panel render and the census positions are the only guide to what each control is; the thirteen buttons down the left edge match the thirteen listed in the manual's LEFT-SIDE MOMENTARY BUTTONS section in the same order. Params 39 and 40 are the two buttons wired by silkscreen to the M and S boxes of the bottom row. The module reads param 39 and writes one repeated byte over all eight of the current pattern's mute flags, then calls checkMuteStates; it reads param 40 and writes eight zero bytes over the solo flags, then calls checkSoloStates. The solo button is therefore certainly an unsolo-everything, and the mute button certainly writes one state to all eight; the byte it writes is only ever set to 1 in the reset paths, which suggests a mute-all rather than a toggle, and the line is worded not to claim a direction. The pattern-CV and CV1/CV2 role wordings come from the SETUP hint text rather than from the manual, which does not list them.
